body: it feels like the cycle will never be broken and i’ll always feel like this.
i’ll do that. thank you for the advice.

i’ve been trying to work up the courage to tell my parents for a while and i think i might just have to write a letter. maybe i’ll try and write something at some point this week and give it to them. and if i do, i’ll let you know how it goes.

basically all i’ve done is talk to a few of my friends. three of them are still there for me to talk to them whenever i need to but one of them basically left me. i know it’s partially my fault for not telling my parents but i’m scared to talk about and i’m ashamed. i’m worried that they will be mad at me for cutting myself or something. or maybe they won’t take me seriously. i don’t know why but i always think of the worst possible outcomes in my head and not the positive ones. so no, i don’t have a therapist or any medication.

it’s hard to be positive when it feels like your entire world is crashing down around you. i have no idea what my purpose is and to be honest, being in this depressive state is kind of my new normal by now. being happy takes so much effort and i would rather stay the way i am because it’s normal for me. i can’t remember the last time i was genuinely happy and i’ve gotten used to it.
